description.text: Teaching Objective The Doctor’s Degree of Management Science and Engineering for foreign students is to train high-lever specialized personnel in engaging in management science research and practice. Educational Requirements 1. Good moral qualities and the spirit of devoting, cooperating, developing and innovating; 2. A good command of basic theories and systematic professional knowledge, and understanding of the frontier trends in the profession; 3. The ability of doing management scientific research independently, and the ability of applying professional knowledge to analyze and solve practical problems; 4. the ability of doing statistics analysis, case study, countermeasure analysis and applying qualitative analysis and quantitative analysis; 5. At least one creative research fruit in management science and engineering field; 6. A fairly good grasp of computer. Major Course Optimization Theory and Method Advanced Mathematics Model International Marketing Management Modern Enterprise Institution Advanced Organizational Development Enterprise Risk Mangement Multinational Company Financial Risk Management and Performance Evaluation Operations Management Management Science Management Research Methods Product Innovation Management Strategic Management of Technology and Innovation Duration 3 academic years

duration.text: The Management Science and Engineering at Wuhan University of Technology is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4861 USD/per year ￥ 35000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Health certificate Photocopy of notarized foreigner physical examination record (for durations of study over 6 months) 2.Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 3.Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 4.Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. 5.Letter of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents 6.Research plan 7.Postgraduate school transcript

requirements.text: 1. The TOEFL IBT score of 70 points at least, or IELTS score at least 5.5, or the relevant certificates of English as the working and learning language for university study. 2. Completed application form. 3. Notarized Copies of Highest diploma and transcripts. 4. Two recommendation letters. 5. Research Plan 6. Physical Examination Report. 7. Digital photo (Passport size) and photocopy of passport
